description: Built features for a city guide platform in a team of six, using Angular 20 with signals, RxJS, Taiga UI and Leaflet maps. Shipped event editing, the full event card with reviews and favourites, and server-side route filtering. Delivered 120 commits through GitLab merge requests with senior code review — the highest contribution volume on the team.

Built and maintained the backend of a logistics platform: authentication, CRUD operations and REST APIs, documented with Swagger/OpenAPI. Covered the backend with Jest tests to keep it stable. Integrated the React frontend with the Node.js backend in a 5-person Agile team, and took part in code reviews and sprint planning under a senior developer.
